Hi Ella — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

Summary from our call:
- Nova Clinic is evaluating Redwood for patient-facing summarization and clinical note generation behind your VPC gateway.
- Primary compliance needs: HIPAA / BAA, SOC 2 controls, GDPR for EU patients.
- Identity requirements: SSO via SAML (IdP: Okta), automated user provisioning (SCIM preferred), RBAC for super-admins and clinical users.

Open items / asks for us to progress:
1) SOC 2 posture: please confirm current status (Type I / Type II) and target timeline for Type II completion.
2) SCIM scope: we need to know which attributes you want synced (email, employeeId, manager, groups) and whether you need bulk import or JIT provisioning.
3) SAML metadata: can you share your IdP metadata file or endpoint? Prefer SP-initiated flow; note we also support IdP-initiated.
4) RBAC mapping: which Okta groups should map to Redwood roles (admin, billing_admin, clinician, readonly)?
5) Evidence requests: procurement mentioned a vendor security questionnaire — we can start that and attach a short ID/access checklist (attached).

Next steps I propose:
- Ella: confirm SOC 2 status and share IdP metadata + ideal group mappings.
- Procurement: send over the completed vendor security questionnaire or let us know preferred format.
- Ben & Marissa (cc): can you prepare a short technical packet (SAML setup guide, SCIM endpoints, sample admin audit logs) for Nova?

I attached a one-page "ID & Access checklist" to make the ask easier. If useful, we can run a short technical call next week (30–45m) to walk through SCIM attributes and test SSO.

Thanks — Kim

Hi Kim — appreciate the clear recap. A few answers and follow-ups from our side: 

1) SOC 2: we completed Type I in April 2026. Type II is scheduled for pen test and audit in Q4 2026; target report expected by end of January 2027. We will need SOC 2 summary evidence and any control mappings relevant to identity and access.

2) HIPAA / BAA: this is mandatory. Procurement will need a draft BAA and confirmation of data residency options.

3) GDPR: we process some EU patient data; DPA is required. Please include your standard DPA and SCCs if applicable.

4) SAML / SCIM specifics: we are on Okta. High-level asks:
   - SAML: we prefer SP-initiated, but can support IdP-initiated for some workflows. We'll provide IdP metadata.
   - SCIM: want group and user sync (email, givenName, familyName, employeeNumber, manager, groups). Support for SCIM 2.0 is required. JIT provisioning would be a nice-to-have but not mandatory.
   - RBAC: we'll map Okta groups to two admin tiers (platform-admin, security-admin) and clinical roles (clinician, clinician-lite).

5) Evidence: procurement asked specifically for:
   - SAML configuration guide
   - SCIM endpoint spec and sample payloads
   - Example admin audit log showing role changes and who performed them
   - SOC 2 summary or description of relevant controls

I've looped in Procurement (procurement@novaclinic.com) — they'll send the vendor questionnaire as a follow-up. Let us know if you can deliver the technical packet this week so procurement can begin redlining.

Thanks, Ella

Hi Ella — Ben here from Solutions (copied Kim & Marissa). Quick technical answers and attachments (see list below). Happy to demo any of this on a call.

SAML:
- We support SAML 2.0; SP-initiated recommended. We can consume Okta metadata (XML) or an IdP metadata URL.
- We support signed assertions and enforce audience restrictions.

SCIM / provisioning:
- Redwood implements SCIM 2.0 with the common user and group endpoints (/Users, /Groups). We support the attributes you listed (email, givenName, familyName, employeeNumber, manager, groups).
- We support bulk provisioning and incremental sync. JIT provisioning is supported for compatibility, but for your use case SCIM sync + group mapping is the recommended flow.

RBAC / admin controls:
- Built-in roles: platform-admin, security-admin, billing-admin, clinician, clinician-lite, read-only.
- Roles can be mapped from Okta groups; we also support attribute-based role assignment.
- All role changes are stored in an immutable audit log (timestamp, actor, change). We can provide an excerpt.

Audit logs / evidence:
- Attached: admin-audit-sample.csv (sample, redacted), SOC2-summary.pdf (control areas relevant to IAM), saml-setup-guide.pdf, scim-endpoints.csv.
- We can generate a custom export showing admin role-change events for the timeframe you indicate.

Next steps from our side:
- Kim/Marissa: I'll upload the packet to the secure Drive link and DM access.
- Ella/Procurement: If you want, we can schedule a 30m technical session to walk through SCIM attribute mapping and test the first provisioning. I have availability Wed 7/22 10:00–11:30 PT and Thu 7/23 14:00–16:00 PT.
